items.desc: The Secretary-General has condemned mounting civilian casualties in southern Lebanon and called on Israel to withdraw its forces from Lebanese territory, as fighting intensifies in and around Nabatieh.

items.desc: Use of data-intensive technologies – in particular artificial intelligence (AI) data centres – is growing faster than electricity infrastructure can handle, the UN’s economic commission for Europe has warned, raising concerns about the future reliability and resilience of energy systems worldwide.

items.title: Syria’s transition hinges on justice for all, UN Human Rights Council hears

items.title: Tobacco use can undermine fertility, UN health agency warns

items.title: US student visa issuances plunge 23% amid tighter immigration scrutiny
